subject: Strange png related problem using knitr

messages.author: 1e240ea6410384f7
messages.subject: Strange png related problem using knitr
parts:
Hello all,


I use knitr via calling R on the command line as follows:
*******************
$ R CMD BATCH knitrscript.r
*******************

'knitrscript.r' contains:
*******************
$ cat knitrscript.r
require(knitr)
require(markdown)
knit("rmarkdownscript.rmd", "temp.md", env= new.env())
markdownToHTML("temp.md", "dataset_177.html")
*******************

You see, knitr takes in the R Markdown script 'rmarkdownscript.rmd', which contains a bunch of comments and R code, which I won't paste here (since not relevant).

I got this error when knitr tries to knit the Rmd file:

label: plotting and writing (with options)
List of 2
 $ message: logi FALSE
 $ echo   : logi FALSE

Quitting from lines 33-43 (rmarkdownscript.rmd)
Error in png(..., res = dpi, units = "in") : X11 is not available
Calls: knit ... mapply -> <Anonymous> -> do.call -> <Anonymous> -> png

Execution halted
*******************

Now, this happens only when this action is executed via a bash file.
After the error, when I manually go to the directory, and execute 'R CMD BATCH knitrscript.r' by hand, every completes just fine.

Does anybody of you have a hint on what's wrong?


Thanks for any support,
Joachim

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Strange png related problem using knitr
parts:
Interesting. Can you add capabilities() to the beginning of your code
and post the results? I'm wondering why png() had to use X11; it might
be that Cairo was missing. What is your OS and how you installed R?

Regards,
Yihui
